title: Kinetic Studio
summary: 32 motion-graphics trailers made with code: GSAP, canvas, WebGL and synthesised audio.

p: A lab where each trailer is a page drawn live in the browser. The audio is synthesised too (WebAudio): there is no recorded music.

list: One paused master timeline per trailer: in the kit trailers, any frame can be frozen with ?t=.
Scores as data, synced with the image.
Particles in canvas and WebGL, text that turns into stars, simulations with a fixed seed.

p: The «Meet Ignacio» trailer on this site is made with the Kinetic Studio kit: 15 scenes in 112 seconds, with synthesised music and real components of my projects rebuilt in code.
The kit is copied into every folder and has drifted apart. Unifying it is next.
